content_html:
Three Grounds of Mind

Evolutionary ↔ Cognitive ↔ Metaphysical

We can situate the familiar “layers” of human cognition within a broader vertical spectrum. The Lower Ground captures evolution’s substrate; the Middle Ground summarizes contemporary cognitive neuroscience; the Higher Ground sketches metaphysical horizons that various traditions and theories explore.
